name: Melancholia
description: This is the first LoRA from RassvetAI, which is based on the works of the real author. I present you the works of the artist Kirill Stryukov . ( Instagram ). It is difficult for me to describe this style, as I do not understand the directions of modern art, rather evaluate emotionally, what is closer to my heart. These works are like therapy for me. If you like the post-Soviet aesthetics of paneled districts, open spaces of industrial suburbs, night lights on remote city highways, melancholic night yards surrounded by paneled high-rises, long walks among city alleys - all this is now possible thanks to LoRA's 'Melancholia'. I have no commercial gain from this LoRA, and all copyright issues, if any, will be resolved with the author of the original paintings.
